map.BER 与 Eb/N0、SNR 换算 使用指南: BER, Eb/N0 and SNR Conversion User Guide
map.区分 Eb/N0 与带宽内 SNR 两种口径，按 R/B 换算；容量只在带宽内: Separate the Eb/N0 and in-band SNR bases and convert via R/B; capacity is computed only under the in-band SNR basis and is omitted when undetermined.
map.Eb/N0 口径：直接算 BPSK BER，容量不可用。: Eb/N0 basis: compute BPSK BER directly; capacity is unavailable.
map.SNR 口径：Eb/N0 = SNR − 10log10(R/B)，容量 = l: SNR basis: Eb/N0 = SNR − 10log10(R/B); capacity = log2(1+SNR linear).
map.R 与 B 必须用相同单位（Mbps/MHz 的比值即 bit/s/Hz）。: R and B must use the same unit ratio (Mbps/MHz gives bit/s/Hz).
map.SNR 口径填写比特率 R 与带宽 B。: For the SNR basis, enter bit rate R and bandwidth B.
map.读取 BER、Eb/N0 与容量；Eb/N0 口径不应出现容量数值。: Read BER, Eb/N0 and capacity; the Eb/N0 basis must not show a capacity value.
map.SNR=10dB、R=2Mbps、B=1MHz ⇒ Eb/N0=6.99dB，容: SNR=10 dB, R=2 Mbps, B=1 MHz ⇒ Eb/N0=6.99 dB; capacity still uses SNR=10 dB and gives 3.4594 bit/s/Hz. Do not put Eb/N0 directly into the capacity formula.
